problem_text:
A logistics manager is assembling a fleet of cargo drones for a critical three-phase delivery mission. They must select a combination of packages to maximize total priority score while staying within the payload limit of the drone carrier.

The packages available are:
* Package A: weight 5kg, priority 41 points
* Package B: weight 5kg, priority 161 points
* Package C: weight 12kg, priority 149 points
* Package D: weight 48kg, priority 134 points
* Package E: weight 43kg, priority 54 points
* Package F: weight 7kg, priority 107 points
* Package G: weight 3kg, priority 165 points
* Package H: weight 28kg, priority 141 points
* Package I: weight 6kg, priority 271 points
* Package J: weight 39kg, priority 26 points
* Package K: weight 2kg, priority 76 points
* Package L: weight 43kg, priority 129 points
* Package M: weight 6kg, priority 227 points
* Package N: weight 9kg, priority 189 points
* Package O: weight 5kg, priority 115 points
* Package P: weight 15kg, priority 252 points
* Package Q: weight 50kg, priority 300 points
* Package R: weight 6kg, priority 277 points
* Package S: weight 15kg, priority 270 points
* Package T: weight 30kg, priority 90 points
* Package U: weight 30kg, priority 201 points
* Package V: weight 16kg, priority 81 points
* Package W: weight 8kg, priority 166 points
* Package X: weight 32kg, priority 268 points
* Package Y: weight 43kg, priority 40 points
* Package Z: weight 26kg, priority 121 points
* Package AA: weight 28kg, priority 242 points
* Package AB: weight 38kg, priority 74 points
* Package AC: weight 49kg, priority 207 points

Due to regulatory protocols, exactly one of Package A and Package B must be included in the shipment.

If Package C is selected, it necessitates a specialized cooling unit that reduces the effective carrier payload capacity by 10 kg.
The maximum gross payload the carrier can handle is 452 kg. The manager must determine the optimal set of packages to load.
